lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Large, high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a cluster of five primary nodes visible in the region superior to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, forming a structural grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge runs along the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp luminance transition between the light-reflecting dorsal-facing surface and the shadowed ventral-facing groove.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, circular, pinkish-purple anomaly or lesion is present on the lower lateral flank, located immediately posterior to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a distinct pattern transition from large, discrete white spots at its proximal attachment to a dense field of fine, low-intensity speckling towards its distal margin.
